import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    dim = inputs["dim_emp_hist"].copy()
    q = inputs["asof_queries"].copy()

    # Coerce date-like columns to datetime for correct comparisons,
    # preserving NaT for NULL eff_end_date.
    dim["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_start_date"])
    dim["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_end_date"])
    q["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(q["as_of_date"])

    # Inner join on emp_id (Cartesian per emp_id, then filter by interval).
    merged = q.merge(
        dim,
        on="emp_id",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_h"),
    )

    start_ok = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    end_ok = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    matched = merged.loc[start_ok & end_ok]

    result = matched[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"asof_result": result}
